description: This file contains a PHP class named ReturnReason, which is part of the Opencart admin module, specifically handling CRUD operations for 'Return Reasons' in the localisation namespace. The class includes methods for listing, form display, save, delete, and other administrative functions related to return reasons within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class for managing return reasons in the localisation namespace of OpenCart's admin module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the localisation/return_reason language file, set up breadcrumbs, and display the list of return reasons with pagination and sorting options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to output the list of return reasons in JSON format or as a view, depending on request.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Private method that retrieves and formats the list of return reasons according to current sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays and processes the form for adding or editing a return reason.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing return reason, including permission checks, validation, and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return reasons after permission validation.
